system.effect: Run a Silk Line between two points up to 5 squares apart — as your Action, or for 1 Silk Point to skip the roll. It's safe footing the crew can climb or cross with no Acrobatics roll: up a wall, across a gap, along a ceiling. It holds up to two spiders at once and stays until it's broken or the scene ends.
system.description: Silk is always available. It also does the small stuff without ceremony — anchoring a drop, tying off a light object, lowering a crewmate.
